# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the current stable release line.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 2.0.x | Yes |
| < 2.0 | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub Issues.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:

https://github.com/al5dy/Turgenev/security/advisories/new

When reporting a vulnerability, please include:

- the affected plugin version;
- the affected WordPress and PHP versions;
- a clear description of the issue;
- reproduction steps or a proof of concept when possible;
- the potential security impact;
- any suggested mitigation or fix, if known.

Please do not include real API keys, credentials, private content, or other secrets in reports.

## Scope

Security reports concerning the WordPress plugin itself are handled in this repository.

Issues affecting the external Turgenev service, provider accounts, billing, infrastructure, API availability, or provider-side processing should be reported to the Turgenev service provider directly.

## Disclosure

Please allow reasonable time for investigation and remediation before publicly disclosing a vulnerability.

Once a fix is available, affected users should update to the latest stable plugin release.
